clauses.code: void compute(int a[], int n, int b[], int m, int c[], int *from_a[]) { int i = 0, j = 0, k = 0; while(i < n && j < m) { if(a[i] < b[j]) { c[k] = a[i]; from_a[k++] = 1; i++; } else { c[k] = b[j]; from_a[k++] = 0; j++; } } while(i < n) { c[k] = a[i++]; from_a[k++] = 1; } while(j < m) { c[k] = b[j++]; from_a[k++] = 0; } }

clauses.code: int compute(int sa[], int na, int sb[], int nb, int marks[]) { int combined[200], idx = 0; for(int i = 0; i < na; i++) { combined[idx] = sa[i]; marks[idx++] = 1; } for(int j = 0; j < nb; j++) { combined[idx] = sb[j]; marks[idx++] = 0; } for(int i = 0; i < na + nb - 1; i++) { for(int j = i + 1; j < na + nb; j++) { if(combined[i] > combined[j]) { int tc = combined[i]; combined[i] = combined[j]; combined[j] = tc; int tm = marks[i]; marks[i] = marks[j]; marks[j] = tm; } } } return na + nb; }

clauses.code: int compute(int d1[], int n1, int d2[], int n2, int mark[]) { typedef struct { int val; int src; } Pair; Pair pairs[200]; int cnt = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n1; i++) { pairs[cnt].val = d1[i]; pairs[cnt++].src = 1; } for(int i = 0; i < n2; i++) { pairs[cnt].val = d2[i]; pairs[cnt++].src = 0; } for(int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) { for(int j = i+1; j < cnt; j++) { if(pairs[i].val > pairs[j].val) { Pair tmp = pairs[i]; pairs[i] = pairs[j]; pairs[j] = tmp; } } } for(int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) mark[i] = pairs[i].src; return cnt; }
